summary_rationale: Price-blind forensic audit confirms an extraordinary full-stack computing compounder: revenue scaled 31x over the past decade from $6.91B (FY17) to $215.94B (FY26) and reached $115.8B in Q3 FY27 alone (+103% YoY), with FY26 ROIC of 74.23%, 71.1% GAAP gross margin (74.8% in Q3 FY27), $102.72B operating cash flow, $96.68B free cash flow, and $53.5B in cash and marketable debt securities (plus $44.2B in marketable equity securities and $65.5B in non-marketable securities) against $32.37B long-term debt (up from $7.47B at FY26 year-end after $24.90B 9M FY27 debt issuance). CUDA, NVLink 6, Mellanox/Spectrum networking, and the rapid Vera Rubin NVL72 ramp (~$20B in its debut quarter) form a formidable architectural moat. However, kpi_health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH due to four material operational risks: (1) the Nov 11-12, 2026 resignation of co-founder CEO Jensen Huang, leaving CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO and 33-year director Harvey C. Jones as Board Chair during a permanent CEO search; (2) off-balance-sheet obligations surging to $668B ($518B commitments including $390B supply and $102B cloud/leases, $32B neocloud agreements, and $118.0B credit support guarantees led by $105.0B for SB Energy/OpenAI) alongside rapid working-capital expansion ($81.03B AR at 64 DSO with extended payment terms, $39.72B inventory, $680M Q3 inventory provisions) and $1.85B Q3 private-equity impairment; (3) Q4 FY27 gross margin compression to a guided 71.0%-72.0% trough due to Rubin ramp and rising memory prices; and (4) 36% Q3 direct revenue concentration in three customers (48% in four customers for 9M FY27), hyperscaler custom ASIC substitution, and $2.4B Q3 China Hopper shipments dropping to $0 assumed China Data Center compute in Q4 FY27.
